archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) modified for Tactical Control Room

rules.headings: Use Chivo for all UI headings to project authority. No Inter for headings.
rules.data: Use JetBrains Mono for ALL numeric data (temperatures, humidity, timestamps) to look like a NASA terminal.

layout_and_spacing.container: Dense, full width grid or max-w-screen-2xl, generous p-6 or p-8 container padding.
layout_and_spacing.grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
layout_and_spacing.cards: Sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). Flat design, NO shadows. Rely on 1px solid borders for definition.

components.surfaces: GRID BORDERS strategy. Expose the skeleton. Technical look. No gradients. Background must match parent, separated by sharp 1px borders.
components.alerts: High contrast solid blocks for critical errors (e.g. Power Cut = Solid Red background, White text, hard edges).
components.charts: Recharts with JetBrains Mono labels. Use 1px stroke lines. No soft gradient fills beneath lines to maintain Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
components.buttons: Sharp corners, high contrast. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), text color must remain visible.

hero_background.description: Abstract dark mode tech background. Use faintly (10% opacity) behind the main layout or header.

product_reference.description: Macro artichoke with frost. Use as an ambient background in the 'AI Insights/Optimum Conditions' bento card with an overlay.

warehouse_image.description: Industrial warehouse interior. Use as a thumbnail for the 'Warehouse Status' selector.

features.real_time_metrics: Massive Mono typography for Temp & Humidity. Must dominate the screen visually.
features.power_cut_alert: Persistent, highly visible banner or pulsing neon red element when active.
features.multi_warehouse: Sidebar or top tabs with status dots (Cyan = Online/Cold, Red = Offline/Power Cut).
features.ai_insights: A dedicated AI advice section specifically calculating optimal artichoke storage parameters.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page dense dashboard using The Control Room Grid.
Use ONLY Turkish language for all UI text (e.g., 'Depo Sıcaklığı', 'Nem Oranı', 'Elektrik Kesintisi', 'Sistem Devrede').
Override default Shadcn styles: strip away rounded corners, remove drop shadows, use sharp 1px borders.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements and metric displays.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Do NOT use standard Vercel/Stripe SaaS looks.
Implement Recharts for live data visualization.
Provide a simulated state toggle for 'Power Outage' to demonstrate the critical alert UI.
